title: Fix non-functional Signup button by adding form submit + validation + success feedback (UI-only)

requirements.text: Wire the green "Signup" button on the Signup screen (frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx) to a real form submit handler so it is never a dead button in draft mode (UI-only; no backend calls).

quotes: The green Signup button is currently non-functional.
Please fix this by wiring the Signup button to a real form submit handler.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Signup" triggers a submit handler (e.g., form onSubmit) and prevents default page reload behavior.
No backend logic is added (no actor calls, no external services).

requirements.text: On Signup submit, validate required fields and show inline error messages next to the corresponding fields when missing/invalid. At minimum, validate all fields that are presented as required in the UI (e.g., fields marked with "*") and any additional signup-critical fields present on the form (email/password/confirm password).

quotes: On clicking Signup, the form must validate required fields.
If any required field is missing, show inline error messages.

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting with missing required fields displays inline, field-specific error text in English (no generic silent failure).
Errors are cleared/updated appropriately when the user fixes inputs and re-submits.
If Relation is "Other", the custom relation text input is validated as required and shows an inline error when empty.
Password and Confirm Password are validated so that missing values and mismatches show inline errors.

requirements.text: If Signup validation passes (all required fields are filled and valid), show a temporary success response in the UI (no backend). Implement either (A) navigation to a simple "Signup successful / Pending approval" screen/state, or (B) a clear success message on the Signup screen using existing UI components (e.g., shadcn Alert).

quotes: If all fields are filled, show a temporary success action (for now):
Either navigate to a “Signup successful / Pending approval” screen OR show a clear success message.

acceptanceCriteria: When all required fields are valid, the user sees a clear English success confirmation (e.g., "Signup successful / Pending approval").
Success behavior does not add any backend logic or paid services.
After success, the user has an obvious next action (e.g., a "Back to Login" button) that works.

constraints: Do not add backend logic yet (no Motoko canister changes required for this request).
Do not add paid services or payment flows.
UI + basic interactive behavior only; must work in DRAFT before going live.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Creating real user accounts or persisting signup data.
Integrating Firebase, Firestore, or any external database/service.
